text:
tom_support: Flagging urgent escalation for account Fjordly (acct: FJ-473). Customer hit onboarding quota limit + retry loop on embedding ingestion. Support has a P1 error: 403 on bulk ingest after 2PM PST, failing 35% of records. They are on a trial, renewal due in 3 weeks — at risk. Need CS handoff for priority comms and renewal mitigation. Case: #CS-8852. @elaine_cs cc @sam_csm

elaine_cs: Thanks @tom_support. Can you confirm whether this is isolated to one API key/project or affecting multiple tenants within the account?

tom_support: single workspace + key. Logs show spike in 403s and a throttling header: x-ratelimit-remaining: 0. Also intermittent 502s. We tried a soft retry (1s backoff) which moved throughput but still >20% failure. Sample logs attached in the ticket.

sam_csm: ok — priority: 1) stabilize ingestion so onboarding flows finish, 2) proactive customer comms to avoid churn, 3) put renewal at low risk flag in CRM. Who can do the technical rollback/patch? @nidhi_se?

nidhi_se: I can take the lead on the runtime/ingest side. Initial hypothesis: their ingestion pattern triggers burst throttling due to small batch sizes + no KV cache warmup. Quick mitigations: increase batch size on their client to 256, add exponential backoff, and temporarily raise quota limits for the workspace. I need a support-approved quota bump to test. ETA: 90m for a patch and test on staging, then 30m for canary.

lisa_ops: I can approve the temporary quota bump for up to 24h — please provide exact numbers and the workspace id. Also, should we enable prefix caching for them?

nidhi_se: workspace id: fj-473-nyc. Requesting bump from 200 r/s to 1500 r/s for 1 hour while we validate. Enabling prefix KV cache could help but needs a quick config toggle on dedicated serving. Could be toggled if quota bump doesn't fully resolve.

tom_support: Customer is currently blocked from finishing onboarding steps (they uploaded 12k records, 4k failed). They are on a demo at 11AM tomorrow with their execs. If we can't stabilize before that, they'll likely pause.

elaine_cs: Understood. Sam, I'll draft a short customer note. Plan to send 1) immediate acknowledgement + ETA, 2) follow-up when patch deployed, 3) final confirmation once onboarding finishes. Proposed phrasing: "Thanks for flagging — we're actively working this and expect a fix within ~2h. We'll keep you updated every 30 minutes and confirm when ingestion completes. If you'd like, we can join your demo tomorrow to ensure nothing else pops up." Thoughts?

sam_csm: wording is good. Add: we can offer a 30-day trial extension if onboarding can't be completed before renewal/contract milestone. Also log as high-risk in Gainsight.

elaine_cs: Good call. I'll note the extension offer and flag renewal team. 

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging patch by 1769000090, canary deploy 1769000160, full rollout pending canary success.

nidhi_se: Patch ready in staging. Applying now. Running smoke tests — will post results + request quota bump confirmation.

tom_support: Confirmed customer accepted being contacted and will hold the demo if we can stabilize by 11AM. They share sample payloads in ticket.

lisa_ops: Quota bump applied to fj-473-nyc: 1500 r/s for 2 hours (admin-lisa). Monitoring dashboards updated.

nidhi_se: Staging smoke tests passed. Canary started. 5 minute observation window.

elaine_cs: Drafted customer message and saving to ticket. Copy below: 
"Hi team — thanks for the patience. We've identified a throttling issue affecting ingestion for your workspace and are deploying a fix. We've temporarily raised your ingest quota and will monitor. Expect updates every 30 minutes; next update at +30m. If helpful, we can join your demo."

sam_csm: Send now. Also set a follow-up reminder for me + elaine in 3 hours.

elaine_cs: Sent to customer at 1769000028. They replied: "Appreciate the quick response. Please confirm once all failures resolved."

nidhi_se: Canary looks good — failure rate down to 0.8% on the canary slice. Requesting to proceed with rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary success. Proceeding to full rollout. Full rollout scheduled immediate.

nidhi_se: Full rollout complete. Failure rate on production now 0.9% and ingestion throughput restored to expected levels.

elaine_cs: Great. I sent confirmation to the customer and offered a 30-day trial extension as discussed. Customer accepted extension and asked for a wrap-up email and the remediation notes.

sam_csm: Logged renewal risk reduced. Will follow up with Renewal Ops to update the account milestone.

lisa_ops: Reverted quota bump back to baseline at 1769000035.

elaine_cs: Summary/action items:
- Tech: patch deployed by @nidhi_se, production failure rate reduced.
- Ops: quota bump applied then reverted by @lisa_ops.
- CS: customer notified, 30-day extension granted, renewal risk downgraded by @sam_csm.
- Follow-ups: post-mortem and ingestion best-practice guide to be sent to Fjordly by EOD.

If anything else pops up I'll re-open the thread. Thanks team :tada:
